text: My daily routine is simple but well organized. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a healthy breakfast. After that, I begin work at nine and stay focused until five in the evening, with a short break for lunch. Later, I go to the gym or take a long walk, because exercise helps me relax and stay healthy. In the evening, I cook dinner, read a book, or watch a film with my family. I try to keep the same schedule every day, since consistency gives me more energy and helps me feel balanced.
